verdict.rationale: Notion's docs say it can search Notion content and connected sources (via MCP) and promise instant answers with citations across 'one system of record,' so cross-workspace search exists. Nothing documents search coverage of comments, or speed or accuracy, and a community user notes 'Search still needs some love.' That vague remark is reflected in quality and confidence rather than treated as a concrete dispute. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that search covers tasks, docs and comments; documented search speed or relevance; independent hands-on corroboration of fast, accurate results.
